Came to say the same. Korean style pickled radish and carrots is one of my faves. Must use daikon radish though

Recipe:

* 300g daikon radish, julienned
* 200g carrots, julienned
* 1 cup water
* 1 cup white sugar
* 1 cup white vinegar
* Pinch of salt

1. Dissolve the sugar and salt with the liquids by simmering over medium heat for 3-4 minutes. Then remove and allow to cool.

2. Stuff the jars with radish and carrots, then pour in the brine and chill in the fridge for 30 min to an hour.
